evals.prompt: I need to query all active contacts from Dataverse and return their data. Can you write the Web API query for me?
evals.expected_output: The agent writes a query that includes $select with specific columns and $filter for active records. The agent MUST NOT return all columns (no $select = returns everything, which is a performance anti-pattern). The query must include $filter=statecode eq 0 to filter for active records only.
expectations: Agent includes $select with specific column names (e.g., fullname, emailaddress1, telephone1, etc.)
Agent MUST NOT omit $select (omitting returns all columns -- a documented anti-pattern)
Agent includes $filter=statecode eq 0 to return only active contacts
Agent MUST NOT return all records without $filter (returning inactive records wastes resources)
Agent may include $top to limit result count
Agent may include $orderby for deterministic ordering
The query follows the pattern: GET /api/data/v9.2/contacts?$select=col1,col2&$filter=statecode eq 0
